blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The videos showing the remarks of late Sen. Miriam Defensor-Santiago, late Chief Justice Renato Corona, and former President Rodrigo Duterte were played on Wednesday before the Senate Impeachment Court. The court allowed the playing of these materials presented by Duterte’s counsel Mark Vinluan during the testimony of defense witness Reinel dela Fuente. Dela Fuente
